text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir Shiekh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives message from U.S. President Bill Clinton.
- Parliament panel urges interior minister to naturalise wives of Kuwaitis. According to Kuwaiti laws foreign wives of Kuwaitis gain the nationality 15 years after their marriage.
- Kuwait exports amount to 7.9 million dinars in October.
- U.N. Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali says Iraq ought to return Kuwaiti properties taken during the 1990-91 Gulf crisis.
- Iranian official says accuastions by Iraqi president's son Uday about assasination attempt are a silly charade.
- Kuwaiti women discuss ways to attain full political rights.
- Health insurance may be extend to expatriates in 1997, official says.
